description: Rent compute power via args. Provide `type` ("small" | "large") and `hours` (1–72). Use this tool when you (the agent) or the user need to rent a VM / compute capacity for a specific type and duration - e.g. to run a job, host a service, or offload compute. Price: `small` = 2 vCPU / 4GB RAM / 50GB SSD → 0.02 USDC/h, `large` = 4 vCPU / 8GB RAM / 80GB SSD → 0.04 USDC/h. Min 1h. OS Ubuntu 22.04 (fixed). If you have a balance (see `top_up_balance`) and it covers the price, pass `buyerID` to pay from balance without a 402 challenge. Otherwise the first call WITHOUT a payment signature returns isError=true with `x402Version`+`accepts` in structuredContent - sign those accepts and retry with `_meta["x402/payment"]` (base64 payload). On success returns VM SSH access credentials (ip, port, password, expires_at, slot_id) which are also saved in `get_my_history` -> orders.rtc[slot_id]. If the VM cannot be created after payment, the call is refunded automatically (structuredContent.refunded=true). Limits per IP: 15 free probes/h, then paid calls limited.

buyerID.description: Optional 16-char buyer ID (meta.yourID from any paid response). Pass it in the first call to skip the 402 challenge when balance covers the price.
